import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Restore from git
print("=== Restoring from git ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria_new && git checkout package.json package-lock.json 2>/dev/null")
print("Restored from fresh clone")
# Copy the correct package.json to the original location
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cp /opt/areloria_new/package.json /opt/areloria/package.json")
print("Copied to /opt/areloria")
# Copy server package.json too
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cp /opt/areloria_new/server/package.json /opt/areloria/server/package.json")
print("Copied server package.json")
# Check it's correct now
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("head -10 /opt/areloria/package.json")
print("\n=== Restored package.json ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
PYEOF
